title: Global unique solvability of the 1D stochastic Navier-Stokes-Korteweg equations
summary: We prove the global well-posedness of the one-dimensional Navier-Stokes-Korteweg equations driven by a stochastic multiplicative noise. The analysis is performed for the general case of capillarity and viscosity coefficients $k(ρ)= ρ^β, \, β\in \mathbb{R},\, μ(ρ)=ρ^α, \, α\ge 0,$ which are not coupled through a BD relation. Global existence and uniqueness of solutions is obtained in the regularity class of strong pathwise solutions, which are strong solutions in PDEs and also in the sense of probability.
